verdict.rationale: The AMD Ryzen 9 9950X3D is a desktop CPU, a hardware product. Versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy belong to software services and platforms, so this story is a category error for this kind of product. The bare 'Learn About Ryzen AI Software For Developers' link and the Ryzen Master utility mentions do not show that the processor ships versioned APIs or any deprecation policy, so the axis does not flip to applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
